##### Project general facts

Sealine Residence by Al Zorah Development Company is a contemporary residential building that blends clean architectural form with coastal charm. The building rises above three ground levels to nine residential floors, with homes arranged around green courtyards that bring light and calm into the heart of the project. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments in simplex and duplex layouts, complemented by a small selection of retail shops at ground level for everyday convenience.

Amenities are designed for an active and relaxed coastal lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a large swimming pool surrounded by landscaped decks, together with a fully equipped gym for daily workouts. Green courtyards create shaded places to rest, read and meet neighbours, while direct access to a private beach offers swimming and sunbathing close to home. Covered parking, secure access and retail outlets within the building complete the shared spaces for residents and their guests.

Interiors are bright and practical, with open-plan living and dining areas that flow onto private balconies. Large windows bring in natural light and frame views of the greenery, the creek and the sea. Lower-floor homes enjoy direct garden access, while duplex layouts add generous space for families. Kitchens are fitted with quality appliances, and homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Zorah City is an award-winning mixed-use coastal destination in Ajman, combining a white sandy beachfront, a calm inland creek and one of the oldest protected mangrove forests in the UAE. Green spaces, landscaped gardens and pedestrian paths cover much of the community, creating a healthy, nature-led setting for families and residents who enjoy the outdoors, with calm waters ideal for swimming and snorkelling.

The Nicklaus Design championship golf course, The Oberoi Beach Resort, the Zoya Health and Wellbeing Resort and several marinas sit within the community. Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Dubai, Sharjah International Airport and Dubai International Airport, while Ajman City Centre, schools, universities and hospitals are a short drive away, and the marinas offer convenient access by boat or yacht.

Al Zorah City is a freehold destination open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive coastal communities in the northern emirates. Apartments with private beach access and resort amenities attract families, professionals and holiday home buyers. Accessible entry points compared with Dubai, combined with a mature lifestyle offer, support steady rental demand and healthy long-term value for owners and investors.
